blocks.text: PIANO REMOVAL FAQ
Piano Removal in Mississauga— What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does piano removal cost in Mississauga?
a: Pricing is confirmed free at the walkthrough — forecastable to the dollar, paired with a real arrival window.

items.q: What happens to the piano once it's removed?
a: Donation partners are checked first for pianos that still play; only pianos beyond use go to recycling.

items.q: What's involved in moving a grand or baby grand piano?
a: Legs, the lid and sometimes the pedal lyre come off to fit through doorways, stairwells or elevators, and the piano moves on proper piano boards.

items.q: Can you remove a piano the same day I call?
a: Often, yes — trucks run seven days a week, 6AM to 11PM.

items.q: Do you handle piano removal for clinics or business properties?
a: Yes — after-hours scheduling is available so business operations aren’t disrupted.
